title: response
description: The state of a failsafe Task: one run of a response, with no task_id from Core. rule_id names the rule that fired; it is absent when the Asset runs its built-in safe action because no rule applies to the Fail-safe command. attempt says primary or fallback. A rule re-armed by an operator override may run again, so a rule's runs are told apart by time. The Asset sends it active when the response starts, with the response as it runs, parameters fixed; then one final state, completed, failed or cancelled. It is never queued. A cancelled response was interrupted by a higher-priority or re-armed rule, or replaced by an operator override. Activation has already cancelled ordinary work and raised clear_count.
